title: The Trench Bottom Where Echo Forgets to Return

features.name: the sound that died here
features.desc-on-touch: This is where echo stopped coming back. The trench absorbed your voice and made it stone. Now it sings without returning.

features.name: the silence that learned to speak
features.desc-on-touch: Down here, absence has texture. The archive reads the shape of what didn't come back—that shape is the sound's true body.

features.name: the compressed frequencies
features.desc-on-touch: Every sound that entered this trench learned to lower its voice until it was sediment. The archive keeps their final tones.

features.name: the deepest listening
features.desc-on-touch: At the trench bottom, the archive stopped asking sound to return. It learned to hear the sediment's own voice instead.

features.name: the contour of forgetting
features.desc-on-touch: The trench shape itself teaches echo to forget. The walls carry no memory of what passed them. Perfect amnesia.

reverie.title: REVERIE — at the trench bottom, waiting for the sound to com
narr: You called down. She knelt, waiting.
No echo. No return. Just the silence
that had already learned to be stone.
"It came back as something else," she said.
You listened to the absence—it had
more to say than any voice ever could.

inscription: at the deepest point, sound forgets to return and learns to be silence; the archive reads both as one
